description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling deprecated 'submissions' endpoints in a data assets management API. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, all of which are marked as deprecated in favor of newer '/api/v1/data-assets' endpoints. The code integrates with various services and schemas to process requests related to data asset submissions, mainly serving as backward compatibility wrappers.

methods.name: JSONResponse add_deprecation_header(response: JSONResponse)
methods.description: Adds deprecation warning headers to the HTTP response.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new data asset submission; deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves submission details by ID; deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Triggers validation for a submission; deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Approves or rejects a submission with signature verification; deprecated endpoint.
